question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the word ‘Scrutiny’ from the given sentence.**

The company's strategic plan included a comprehensive analysis of market trends and consumer behaviour.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Scrutiny"** means a close and thorough examination or inspection of something. (सतर्क जांच)

 
 
• **Example:** After the fraud allegations, the company's financial records were subjected to close scrutiny.
 
 
 
• **"Analysis"** refers to a detailed examination of the elements or structure of something, typically as a basis for discussion or interpretation. (विश्लेषण)
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist presented an analysis of the data collected during the experiment.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "Scrutiny" is synonymous with "Analysis".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Behaviour** (व्यवहार): The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

 
 
• **Example:** His behaviour during the meeting was very professional.
 
 
 
• **Comprehensive** (व्यापक): Complete and including all or nearly all elements or aspects of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The report provided a comprehensive overview of the company’s performance.
 
 
 
• **Trends** (रुझान): General direction in which something is developing or changing.
 
 
• **Example:** The latest fashion trends are influencing the clothing market.
